tooltip.rule_dialog.key_name: The output column name for this extracted value. Use lowercase with underscores (e.g. total_amount).
tooltip.rule_dialog.data_type: The expected data type of the extracted value (String, Number, Currency, or Date).
tooltip.rule_dialog.rule_type: How the extraction region is defined: by searching relative to an anchor label, or by a fixed bounding box.
tooltip.rule_dialog.anchor_text: The text label to search for on the page. The value will be extracted relative to this label.
tooltip.rule_dialog.search_mode: How to match the anchor text: exact match, substring (contains), regular expression, or case-insensitive.
tooltip.rule_dialog.direction: The direction to look for the extracted value relative to the anchor text (Right, Below, Left, or Above).
tooltip.rule_dialog.offset_distance: Maximum pixel distance from the anchor label to search for a value. Increase this if the value is far from the label.
tooltip.rule_dialog.match_index: Which occurrence of the anchor text to use when it appears multiple times on the page. 0 = first occurrence.
tooltip.rule_dialog.page_index: Which page to extract from (0-based index). 0 = first page, 1 = second page, etc.
tooltip.rule_dialog.pattern_start_page: The first page to start scanning (0-based). The extractor searches this page and all subsequent pages, returning the first page where the start and end patterns are both found.
tooltip.rule_dialog.has_borders: Whether the table has explicit visible border lines.
tooltip.rule_dialog.extract_as_key_value: Treat table columns as key-value pairs (column 1 as key, column 2 as value).
tooltip.rule_dialog.vertical_strategy: Strategy to detect column boundaries (lines, text, or explicit).
tooltip.rule_dialog.horizontal_strategy: Strategy to detect row boundaries (lines, text, or explicit).
tooltip.rule_dialog.header_rows_count: Number of header rows at the top of the table.
tooltip.rule_dialog.snap_tolerance: Distance tolerance in points for snapping text elements to grid cells.
tooltip.btn.add_table_rule: Draw a bounding box on the canvas to extract a table.
tooltip.batch_dialog.template: The .pdftpl extraction template file defining the rules to apply to each PDF.
tooltip.batch_dialog.input_dir: The folder containing the PDF files to process in the batch job.
tooltip.batch_dialog.output_csv: The file path where the extracted results will be saved as a CSV.
tooltip.settings.language: Select the display language. A restart is required to apply the change.
batch_progress.title: Batch Processing
tooltip.page_spin: Current page (1-indexed). Edit to jump to a specific page.
tooltip.rule_dialog.boundary_mode: How to locate the table: static bounding box drawn on canvas, or dynamic start/end text patterns.
tooltip.rule_dialog.start_pattern: Text or regex pattern marking the start of the table.
tooltip.rule_dialog.end_pattern: Text or regex pattern marking the end of the table.
tooltip.rule_dialog.include_start: Include the start-pattern line in the extracted region.
tooltip.rule_dialog.include_end: Include the end-pattern line in the extracted region.
tooltip.rule_dialog.use_regex: Treat start/end patterns as regular expressions.
tooltip.rule_dialog.skip_k: Skip the first k occurrences of the start pattern and use the (k+1)-th match.
tooltip.rule_dialog.extraction_engine: PyMuPDF4LLM provides better results for borderless and multi-line cell tables.
